name: Money or Morals
source:
This story revolves around Jake (name changeable), the elder son of the Monroe family.

A family name which is well known in the city, a family which owns a big modelling agency that seemingly earns more money than it maybe should.

Jake is 20 years old and is fairly fresh out of school. He still hasn't figured out what he wants to work with, and he doesn't want too much help from his family

because he deems that as being "too easy".

This story will take you through the many different jobs that Jake will try, and how every time, something just doesn't feel right.

Where will he end up? How is he going to support himself financially? Is it going to be morally okay? Who knows...

[From Itch.io]
translation:
故事围绕Monroe家的长子Jake（可改名）展开。

Monroe家族在城里颇有名气，经营着一家大型模特经纪公司，而这家公司的收入似乎高得有些不太正常。

Jake今年20岁，刚毕业不久，尚未想清楚自己想做什么工作。他也不愿过多依靠家里的帮助，

因为他觉得，那样“太容易了”。

在故事中，你将跟随Jake尝试各种不同的工作，而每一次，总有什么让他觉得不对劲。

他最终会何去何从？又要如何赚钱养活自己？他的做法，在道德上站得住脚吗？谁知道呢……
